info.name: Full Text Search Reconcile
info.summary: Safely find stale Files Full Text Search entries.
info.description: Maintenance-only OCC command that compares Full Text Search entries from the files provider with Nextcloud's current filecache. Dry-run is the default. With --reconcile, stale entries are marked INDEX_REMOVE through Nextcloud's public Full Text Search API so the normal FTS indexing process can remove them from the configured search platform. With --unreconcile, pending INDEX_REMOVE marks can be cancelled before the normal FTS indexing process has processed them.
info.author: Eboracum maintenance utility, thx 2 OpenAI
